Head 876-880 concerns GLM prompt contract/tool text not visible. Nemotron Super prefix reuse is documented as partitioned by authenticated tenant cache scope and image identity (head 229-238), consistent with T-041 mitigations; unchanged here. No regression identified from visible evidence; implementation of VFR decode bounds needs source review.
